about: Feature posts on X, drafted by the server and posted only by the owner (infra/alerts/xfeatures.py, up x). Items here are for features whose news has no entry of its own in updates.json (Agorzilla) or that go live later; a feature with an entry carries the same object as its "x" field.

posts.text:
Since tonight, the feeders decide what Agorzilla gets asked.

17 new questions join the 5 from the start: its build, its crown, a toy, a friend, the weather around its rock.

Feed it from a testnet wallet and wish for one. The most-wished question comes next.

#TauNet

Agorzilla won't run out of questions.

From tonight a new one joins every week, from a pool of 24. Colours can be ones nobody picked before, drawn from the hash, like Teal 187°. And from 1 December: winter questions.

#TauNet
